latin: Sciri potest in Cabalam per mysterium mem clausi cur post se Christus miserit paraclytum.
translation: Through the mystery of the closed mem, the Cabala lets us know why Christ, once gone, sent the Paraclete after him.
translation_note: The 'closed mem' is the final form of the Hebrew letter mem, which Jewish commentary noted occurs only once outside word-final position, in Isa. 9:6, a verse both Jewish and Christian readers took as messianic (farmer1998:27307).
